name: ZCA_OBJECTIVE_SPLITS_
description: This entity stores the details about the split based on the dimensions defined for the objective

columns.name: OBJECTIVE_SPLIT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: OBJECTIVE_ID
columns.description: Stores the Objective Id

columns.name: ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Stores the account id, if the dimension of the objective is account

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Stores the geography id, if the dimension of the objective is geography

columns.name: PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: Stores the product id, if the dimension of the objective is product

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Stores the type of the period (Year, Quarter, Fiscal Period), if the dimension of the objective is Time

columns.name: PERIOD_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the accounting calendar

columns.name: DISPLAY_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Stores the Start Period Name of the split

columns.name: TARGET_VALUE
columns.description: Column to hold the target value of the objective split

columns.name: ACTUAL_VALUE
columns.description: Column to hold the actual value of the objective split

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
